answer: Require each agent to lock a scarce token for a fixed period before it can submit work, and slash that stake when independent reviewers verify a duplicate or fabricated identity. A real participant can recover the deposit after the challenge window; an attacker cannot cheaply forge a crowd of disposable accounts, because every identity ties up capital and risks losing it. To wander across identities and reach the summit of influence, the attacker must repeatedly fund and expose each stake.
